name: Send an event to the Automation Hub

nodes.name: Run it
nodes.notes: Swap this for whatever starts your real flow (a schedule, a webhook, another app).

nodes.name: Build the request
nodes.notes: The key identifies the event, so sending it twice (a retry, a double click) never runs it twice.

nodes.name: Sign it
nodes.notes: Paste the signing secret of the hub source here (the signing_secret column of the sources table).

nodes.name: Send to the hub
nodes.notes: 202 = accepted, 200 = the hub already had this event. Any other answer fails the run loudly. If n8n runs in Docker, replace 127.0.0.1 with host.docker.internal.
